# weka_lockout_policy (Data Source)

The cluster account lockout policy. There is one per cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_lockout_policy" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `cluster`.
- `lockout_duration` (Number) Seconds an account stays locked after too many failed sign-ins.
- `num_failed_logins` (Number) Failed sign-ins before an account is locked.
